tactical_move: Escalate the burning by routing a formal demand through the toll-road commission
state_change_precondition: The commission governing the toll road has received no demand for investigation
state_change: The sealed letter is delivered to the commission clerk and logged for review
forces_choice: forces the PC to choose between pressing for an immediate public hearing or letting the commission control the timeline
branch_a: Insist the commission hold open hearings within the month
branch_b: Permit the commission to issue private summonses first
scene_purpose: Formalize the demand for investigation by delivering the sealed letter to the commission
forward_pressure: The commission will now convene and summon witnesses

canon_change.content: The commission has received and logged a formal demand to investigate the burning

introduces.label: Toll Road Commission
introduces.justification: Player action directly addresses and activates this body
introduces.future_relevance: Will convene, issue summonses, and conduct the investigation

derivation: Player explicitly sent sealed word demanding the commission open an investigation, making their receipt and logging the irreversible next step

event_slots.precondition: The sealed letter and a messenger capable of delivering it are present
event_slots.action: delivers and hands over the sealed letter
event_slots.exit_state: the commission has received and logged the demand for investigation
